import pandas as pd

# File paths for the source CSV files
source0_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_79/test_0.csv"
source1_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_79/test_1.csv"

# Load Source 0: 2017 data (no Region column)
df_2017 = pd.read_csv(source0_path)

# Load Source 1: 2015 data (with Region column)
df_2015 = pd.read_csv(source1_path)

# Rename columns in df_2015 to match target schema suffix "_15"
df_2015_renamed = df_2015.rename(columns={
    'Happiness Rank': 'Happiness_Rank_15',
    'Happiness Score': 'Happiness_Score_15',
    'Standard Error': 'Standard_Error_15',
    'Economy (GDP per Capita)': 'Economy_15',
    'Family': 'Family_15',
    'Health (Life Expectancy)': 'Life_Expectancy_15',
    'Freedom': 'Freedom_15',
    'Trust (Government Corruption)': 'Trust_15',
    'Generosity': 'Generosity_15',
    'Dystopia Residual': 'Dystopia_15'
})

# Rename columns in df_2017 to match target schema suffix "_17"
df_2017_renamed = df_2017.rename(columns={
    'Happiness_Rank_17': 'Happiness_Rank_17',
    'Happiness_Score_17': 'Happiness_Score_17',
    'Whisker_High_17': 'Whisker_High_17',
    'Whisker_Low_17': 'Whisker_Low_17',
    'Economy_17': 'Economy_17',
    'Family_17': 'Family_17',
    'Life_Expectancy_17': 'Life_Expectancy_17',
    'Freedom_17': 'Freedom_17',
    'Generosity_17': 'Generosity_17',
    'Trust_17': 'Trust_17',
    'Dystopia_17': 'Dystopia_17'
})

# The key to join on is Country, because:
# - Source0 has Country and 2017 data
# - Source1 has Country, Region, and 2015 data
# We want to join on Country to get Region and 2015 data alongside 2017 data.

# Before join, check for duplicates in Country columns to avoid many-to-many joins
# If duplicates exist, we may need aggregation or deduplication.

# Check duplicates in df_2015_renamed
if df_2015_renamed['Country'].duplicated().any():
    # Aggregate by Country and Region (Region should be unique per Country)
    # For numeric columns, take mean
    agg_cols_2015 = [col for col in df_2015_renamed.columns if col not in ['Country', 'Region']]
    df_2015_renamed = df_2015_renamed.groupby(['Country', 'Region'], as_index=False)[agg_cols_2015].mean()

# Check duplicates in df_2017_renamed
if df_2017_renamed['Country'].duplicated().any():
    # Aggregate by Country, take mean for numeric columns
    agg_cols_2017 = [col for col in df_2017_renamed.columns if col != 'Country']
    df_2017_renamed = df_2017_renamed.groupby('Country', as_index=False)[agg_cols_2017].mean()

# Merge on 'Country' to combine 2015 and 2017 data, including Region from 2015 data
df_merged = pd.merge(df_2015_renamed, df_2017_renamed, on='Country', how='inner')

# Reorder columns to match target schema exactly
target_columns = [
    'Country', 'Region',
    'Happiness_Rank_15', 'Happiness_Score_15', 'Standard_Error_15', 'Economy_15', 'Family_15',
    'Life_Expectancy_15', 'Freedom_15', 'Trust_15', 'Generosity_15', 'Dystopia_15',
    'Happiness_Rank_17', 'Happiness_Score_17', 'Whisker_High_17', 'Whisker_Low_17', 'Economy_17',
    'Family_17', 'Life_Expectancy_17', 'Freedom_17', 'Generosity_17', 'Trust_17', 'Dystopia_17'
]

# Some columns might be float but expected as int (Happiness_Rank_15 and Happiness_Rank_17)
# Convert ranks to int (rounding or floor)
df_merged['Happiness_Rank_15'] = df_merged['Happiness_Rank_15'].round().astype(int)
df_merged['Happiness_Rank_17'] = df_merged['Happiness_Rank_17'].round().astype(int)

# Select and reorder columns
df_target = df_merged[target_columns]

# Save the final dataframe to the target CSV path
output_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_79/target_multisource_cot.csv"
df_target.to_csv(output_path, index=False)

print(f"Transformation complete. Output saved to {output_path}")
